g.text: The complete signed filter and its common-equation residual
Exact constants, all original factors and the full state [SCR1–SCR6]
β is the unique root in (9,10) of 2752β³ − 13296β² − 110508β − 164041 = 0.
The curve is the scalar filter, not the actual spectral density.
No explicit inverse-shift factor; the full equation residual is retained.
The marginal, mixed and complementary terms are all actual full-state terms.
The original cubic constant e₃ remains in the equation for t.
Complete domains, covariance derivatives and proof: SCR1–SCR6.
